source_excerpts.text:
# Count-certified positive predictive gauges

This is a sufficient observable confidence certificate, constructed and tested
here. Its ingredients are positive realizations, interval linear algebra and
coupling of finite-state kernels. Historical novelty and an advantage over an
equally informed positive HMM learner are not established. It does not solve
the general unknown-CP-instrument acquisition problem.

## 1. Supplied interface and exact coordinates

Use S7's finite legal action/outcome library, stationary CP instruments,
repeatable whole-process starts, and supplied architectural upper bound r on
the minimal observable rank. There is no latent state, Kraus, physical gauge,
or exact expectation oracle. Choose r normalized legal preparations p_j by
discarding their outcomes; p_1 is the empty preparation rho_0. Choose r legal
future event tests including trace. Let H contain their joint probabilities,
and H_z their shifted joint probabilities for z=(a,o). All confidence events
cover the entire candidate pool before any data-dependent choice.

On the simultaneous count-confidence event suppose H is nonsingular. The
rank upper bound certifies that its preparations span the observable quotient
V. In preparation coefficients c, the exact instrument is

    C_z = H^{-1} H_z.

This follows by testing the r physical core states, then extending by linearity.
The trace functional is 1^T because all core preparations are normalized.
The actual initial state has coefficient e_1 exactly, not an estimated mean.

Choose an invertible real matrix S with 1^T S=1^T. Its columns specify virtual
states in preparation coordinates; negative entries are allowed. Put

    W_z = S^{-1} H^{-1} H_z S,       c_0 = S^{-1} e_1.

If c_0>=0 and every W_z>=0 entrywise, this is an exact positive realization
of the entire legal process. Indeed sum_o 1^T W_(a,o)=1^T by true causality.
Starting at c_0, products have nonnegative coordinates and exactly the true
word probabilities. After every positive-probability legal history the
normalized coordinate is in the simplex. Induction also covers feedback:
both processes choose the same action at the same observed prefix.

The virtual vertices need not be positive physical density matrices. A finite
positive *predictive* realization is enough to give the correct classical
process from the certified initial state. No claim of a physical CP map f

# An overcomplete observable cone certificate

This extends the square gauge certificate. It is a further sufficient
construction, not an acquired universal CP learner. The positivity/polyhedral
realization framework is standard; the formulas state how to verify a candidate
against the actual count intervals. No historical priority or incumbent
advantage is asserted.

## Count-residual verification

Retain the normalized core and rank-exhaustion assumptions from the governing
theorem. In preparation coefficients the true operators are C_z=H^{-1}H_z.
Choose q>=r virtual vertices as columns of V in R^(r by q), with

    rank V=r,       1_r^T V=1_q^T.

Find a right inverse L in R^(q by r), V L=I_r, and an initial distribution
eta>=0 with V eta=e_1. The mass identities imply 1_q^T L=1_r^T automatically.
V can contain negative entries. Candidate nonnegative lifted operators Khat_z
must have exact joint column sums sum_o 1_q^T Khat_(a,o)=1_q^T.

In any other observable basis replace 1_r^T by its known trace functional
ell^T, and require ell^T V=1_q^T. Then 1_q^T L=ell^T and the identical
proof applies. The exact fixture below uses homogeneous Bloch coordinates
with ell=(1,0,0), rather than preparation coefficients.

Suppose |H-Hhat|<=D_H, |H_z-Hhat_z|<=D_z and an entrywise bound
|H^{-1}|<=M_H has been certified. For each branch compute

    Rhat_z = Hhat_z V - Hhat V Khat_z,
    E_z = |L| M_H [ |Rhat_z| + D_z |V| + D_H |V Khat_z| ].       (1)

If Khat_z-E_z>=0 for every branch, the following exact true positive lift
exists:

    K_z = Khat_z + L(C_z V - V Khat_z).                       (2)

It obeys V K_z=C_z V because V L=I. The error in (2) is bounded entrywise
by (1), using the exact residual H_z V-H V Khat_z. Consequently K_z>=0.
For every action the correction's column-mass sum vanishes:

    sum_o 1_q^T(K_z-Khat_z)
       = 1_r^T[sum_o C_z V - V sum_o Khat_z] = 0.

Here true TP gives 1_r^T sum_o C_z=1_r^T, and the fitted causal identity
gives 1_r^T V sum_o Khat_z=1_q^T. Thus K_z is a true stochastic lift.
Starting at eta, its full word probabilities equal the true instrument's
probabilities by intertwining. The same local box-simplex TV certificate and
full-transcript/clock/reuse coupling apply in q latent labels.

This does not assume an exact observed equality at noisy counts: the measured
residual Rhat is explicitly paid. It also does not assume a physica
